changelog: Trunk catalogs replaced through CLI, MCP-assisted setup or another atomic writer are now detected by the running portal within one second. Trunk attribution ref
The check is bounded to one filesystem revision read per second, stays outside packet capture and does not rewrite CDR data or require a database migration.
changelog_es: Trunk attribution now detects atomic catalog replacements made outside the portal process and rebuilds its in-memory index within one second. CLI/MCP-assisted c
Revision checks are rate-limited to one filesystem stat per second and never enter the packet-capture hot path. Database rows are not rewritten; CDR attribution
